title: PRAYAS Scholarship Tripura - SC ST Students
meta_description: PRAYAS Scholarship Tripura supports SC and ST students for higher education. Check eligibility, scholarship amount, how to apply, and documents required.

hero.one_liner: PRAYAS Scholarship helps SC and ST students of Tripura with degree, PG, and professional courses, through a maintenance allowance plus fee support.

what_is_it: The PRAYAS Scholarship (Programme for Reaching and Achieving Young Aspirants for Scholarship) is a Tripura government initiative that provides financial assistance to students from Scheduled Caste (SC) and Scheduled Tribe (ST) communities who are pursuing higher education in degree, post-graduate, and professional courses at colleges and universities. The scholarship covers both a maintenance allowance for the student's living expenses and reimbursement or waiver of tuition fees, making it possible for students from low-income SC and ST families to pursue higher education without the financial constraints that typically limit educational attainment in these communities.

Eligibility for the PRAYAS Scholarship requires the student to be a permanent resident of Tripura, belong to the Scheduled Caste or Scheduled Tribe category as recognised in the Tripura state list, and have a family income below Rs 2.5 lakh per year from all sources. The income limit is verified through a certificate from the Competent Authority, and the student must produce a caste certificate from the appropriate government authority confirming their SC or ST status; students enrolled in a recognised college or university who have cleared their qualifying examination with the minimum required marks are eligible to apply.

how_to_apply.title: Check Eligibility
how_to_apply.description: Confirm you are a Tripura resident, belong to SC or ST community, have family income below Rs 2.5 lakh/year, and are enrolled in a degree, PG, or professional course at a recognised college or university.

how_to_apply.title: Register on Scholarship Portal
how_to_apply.description: Register on the National Scholarship Portal (scholarships.gov.in) or the Tripura state scholarship portal using your Aadhaar number and mobile number; complete the student profile with your academic and personal details.

how_to_apply.title: Fill Application and Upload Documents
how_to_apply.description: Fill the scholarship application form online and upload scanned copies of your caste certificate, income certificate from the Competent Authority, mark sheet of the qualifying exam, college fee receipt, and Aadhaar card.

how_to_apply.title: Institution Verification
how_to_apply.description: Your college or university verifies your enrolment and attendance details on the scholarship portal; ensure your institution has completed this step before the deadline, as unverified applications cannot be processed.

how_to_apply.title: Payment to Bank Account
how_to_apply.description: After approval by the Tribal Welfare or Social Welfare Department, the scholarship amount is credited directly to your Aadhaar-linked bank account via DBT; check your bank account and the portal for payment status.

extra_sections.heading: PRAYAS Scholarship: The Basics
content: Tripura has a large tribal population that includes more than 19 recognised scheduled tribe groups, and ensuring access to higher education for these communities has been a consistent priority of the state government; the PRAYAS Scholarship is one of the mechanisms through which Tripura supports tribal students who qualify for higher education but face financial barriers that prevent them from pursuing their chosen courses. The scholarship complements central government schemes like the Pre-Matric and Post-Matric Scholarship for SC/ST students by providing state-level supplementation for Tripura's SC and ST students.

The scholarship is administered through the Tribal Welfare Department for ST students and the Social Welfare Department for SC students in Tripura; both departments coordinate with the National Scholarship Portal (NSP) and the state's own online scholarship portal to receive, process, and approve applications from eligible students. The departments also coordinate with educational institutions to verify enrolment and attendance records before releasing the scholarship amount to the student's bank account.

extra_sections.heading: PRAYAS Scholarship: Going Deeper
content: The maintenance allowance component of the PRAYAS Scholarship varies depending on whether the student is a day scholar or a hosteller, with hostellers receiving a higher amount to account for accommodation expenses; the rates are periodically revised by the Tripura government to reflect changes in the cost of living. Day scholars receive a lower maintenance allowance than hostellers, though the exact amounts vary by year and course level and students should check the current year's scholarship notification for the applicable rates.

Tuition fee reimbursement under the PRAYAS Scholarship covers the actual tuition fee charged by the institution for the enrolled course, subject to a ceiling set by the state government; for students enrolled in professional courses such as engineering, medical, law, and management, the fee reimbursement can be particularly significant given the high tuition costs at these institutions. Students in government colleges and universities typically have lower tuition fees and therefore lower reimbursement amounts, while students in self-financing private colleges benefit more substantially from the tuition fee component.

extra_sections.title: Support for SC and ST Students of Tripura
extra_sections.content:
The PRAYAS Scholarship helps SC and ST students of Tripura with higher studies. It covers degree, PG, and professional courses.

Students get a maintenance allowance along with help towards fees, so cost is less of a barrier to studying further.

extra_sections.heading: Key Figures
content: The application process for the PRAYAS Scholarship is conducted online through the Tripura government's scholarship portal and also through the National Scholarship Portal (NSP); applicants are required to register with their Aadhaar number, fill in their academic and family income details, upload scanned copies of supporting documents including caste certificate, income certificate, mark sheets, and fee receipts, and submit the application before the prescribed closing date. Late applications are typically not accepted, so students are advised to apply as soon as the scholarship notification is published.

One of the important eligibility conditions for the PRAYAS Scholarship is that the student must not be receiving any other scholarship from the state or central government for the same course and purpose; the scholarship is designed to avoid duplication with other welfare benefits. Students who are already receiving the National Post-Matric Scholarship for SC/ST students from the central government are generally expected to check whether they can also receive the PRAYAS top-up, or whether the PRAYAS scholarship is available only to students who are not covered by the central scheme.

extra_sections.heading: Key Figures: Key Points
content: The PRAYAS Scholarship covers a wide range of courses including arts, science, commerce, law, engineering, medical science, pharmacy, nursing, teacher education, and management; the breadth of eligible courses reflects the government's intent to support SC and ST students regardless of which professional or academic stream they choose to pursue. Students pursuing distance education or correspondence courses from recognised universities are also typically eligible, which widens the scholarship's reach to working students who cannot attend full-time classes.

Tripura's scheduled tribe communities, particularly in the TTAADC areas and the remote hill districts, have historically had lower higher education enrolment rates than the state's general population; the PRAYAS Scholarship directly addresses one of the key barriers to higher education by removing the financial constraint. Government data on the scholarship has shown year-on-year increases in the number of ST applicants, reflecting both growing awareness and growing aspirations among tribal youth for college-level education.

extra_sections.heading: Who the Scheme Covers
content: Students who receive the PRAYAS Scholarship are required to maintain satisfactory academic performance and minimum attendance as prescribed by their institution; the scholarship is not automatic for each subsequent year and renewal requires the student to demonstrate that they have passed the previous year's examination and maintained the required attendance. Students who fail their examinations or have low attendance may face suspension of the scholarship for the subsequent year.

The disbursement of the PRAYAS Scholarship is done directly to the student's Aadhaar-linked bank account through the DBT mechanism, ensuring that the scholarship amount reaches the intended beneficiary without intermediaries; the DBT payment system has eliminated the delays and diversions that were sometimes associated with manual scholarship disbursement. Students are required to link their bank account with Aadhaar before the scholarship payment is processed.

extra_sections.heading: Who the Scheme Covers: Key Points
content: Educational institutions in Tripura are required to verify and certify the enrolment, attendance, and fee payment details of scholarship applicants before the scholarship-processing authority releases payment; institutions that provide false or inaccurate information about students are subject to disqualification from future scholarship processing. This institutional accountability mechanism is important for maintaining the integrity of the scholarship distribution process.

The PRAYAS Scholarship has been credited by educators in Tripura with enabling a generation of SC and ST students to complete their graduation and post-graduation who might otherwise have dropped out due to financial pressures; the scholarship's impact is particularly visible in subjects like law, science, and professional education where the cost of higher education is substantially higher than in arts courses. Many scholarship recipients from rural and tribal areas of Tripura have gone on to careers in government service, teaching, healthcare, and law that would not have been accessible to them without financial support for higher education.

extra_sections.heading: From Form to Approval
content: Female students from SC and ST communities in Tripura receive the same scholarship rates as male students, and the government has made specific efforts to increase female enrolment in the PRAYAS Scholarship by conducting awareness campaigns through schools, Anganwadi centres, and SHG networks; the scholarship is seen as an important tool for improving girls' higher education completion rates in tribal areas, where social and economic factors can discourage girls from pursuing college education. Women enrolled in professional courses like nursing, education, and law have been major beneficiaries of the scholarship.

Tripura's scholarship administration under the PRAYAS scheme has been progressively digitalised, with application processing, institution verification, and payment disbursal all moving to online platforms that reduce processing time and enable tracking of application status by students and parents; the shift to digital processing has also enabled the state to detect and prevent duplicate scholarship applications from the same student across multiple schemes. Students can check their application status online through the state scholarship portal using their registration number and Aadhaar details.

extra_sections.heading: From Form to Approval: More Detail
content: Students from Tripura's SC and ST communities who are pursuing higher education in institutions outside the state, such as in universities in Delhi, Kolkata, or other states, are also typically eligible for the PRAYAS Scholarship provided they are enrolled in a recognised institution and meet all other eligibility conditions; the scholarship is portable within the national higher education system, allowing Tripura's students to pursue courses in any state while remaining covered by their home state's welfare scheme. This portability reflects the Tripura government's commitment to supporting its SC and ST students' educational aspirations wherever those aspirations take them.

The PRAYAS Scholarship also helps address the phenomenon of first-generation learners from SC and ST communities in Tripura who are the first members of their family to attend college; for such students, the financial burden of higher education is felt most acutely because there is no family tradition of managing education-related expenses and no prior experience of availing scholarship facilities. The scholarship provides not just financial support but also a form of institutional recognition that validates their aspiration to pursue higher education.

extra_sections.heading: What the Rules Say
content: Tripura's colleges and universities have benefited indirectly from the PRAYAS Scholarship by retaining students who might have dropped out for financial reasons; higher student retention rates translate into better academic performance statistics for institutions and also reduce the social cost of educational dropout among SC and ST communities. The scholarship's role in improving completion rates for SC and ST students at Tripura's higher education institutions has been acknowledged by the state's education administrators.

The Tribal Welfare Department and Social Welfare Department of Tripura publish the PRAYAS Scholarship notification each year with updated rates, eligible courses, application deadlines, and renewal conditions; students are strongly advised to read the current year's notification carefully before applying, as rates and conditions may change from year to year. The notification is published in local newspapers and on the department's website, and announcements are also made through colleges and universities.

content: The PRAYAS Scholarship ensures that no Scheduled Caste or Scheduled Tribe student in Tripura has to give up their higher education dream due to financial hardship, covering both maintenance costs and tuition fees through direct bank transfer.

extra_sections.heading: What You Will Need
content: The PRAYAS Scholarship's long-term impact on Tripura's SC and ST communities extends beyond the individual student to the broader community; as more scholarship recipients complete higher education and enter professional careers, they serve as role models for younger members of their communities and contribute to a generational shift in educational aspiration. This demonstration effect has been observed in tribal villages where the success of earlier scholarship recipients has motivated younger siblings and neighbours to pursue higher education, creating a virtuous cycle of educational attainment.

Students pursuing technical and vocational diploma courses at polytechnics and industrial training institutes may also be eligible for state welfare scholarships in Tripura, though the specific eligibility conditions differ from those of the PRAYAS Scholarship for degree-level courses; students in such courses should check with the Tribal Welfare or Social Welfare Department for the applicable scheme. The government recognises that vocational education is an equally valid path for SC and ST youth and has sought to ensure that scholarship support is available for this stream as well.

extra_sections.title: What You Will Need Notes
extra_sections.content:
The Tripura government has been working to increase the awareness of the PRAYAS Scholarship among students in Class 12 who are preparing to transition to college, so that they apply for the scholarship from the very first year of their higher education rather than discovering it midway through their course; high school teachers and counsellors in Tripura have been briefed to inform eligible SC and ST students about the scholarship before they complete their board examinations. Early awareness ensures that students can factor the scholarship support into their college selection decisions.

The disbursement timing of the PRAYAS Scholarship is an important practical concern for students, as delays in payment can force students to borrow money or drop out temporarily while waiting for the scholarship to arrive; Tripura's scholarship administration has been making efforts to speed up the end-to-end processing time from application submission to bank credit, with targets set for institution verification turnaround and department approval timelines. Students who experience delays beyond the official processing period can follow up with the department's scholarship helpdesk.

extra_sections.heading: What the Rules Say: Going Deeper
content: For students who face difficulties with the online application process due to limited internet access or digital literacy, Common Service Centres (CSCs) across Tripura can provide assisted application filing services; CSC operators can help students register on the scholarship portal, fill the application form, and upload the required documents. This assisted digital access mechanism is particularly important in Tripura's rural and tribal areas where internet connectivity and digital skills are still limited among the student population.

Scholarship grievances, such as delayed payment, rejection of a valid application, or discrepancy in the scholarship amount, can be filed with the Tribal Welfare Department or Social Welfare Department at the district or state level; the National Scholarship Portal also has a grievance module where students can log complaints and track resolution. Students are advised to retain all application acknowledgement receipts and document upload confirmations as evidence in case of grievances.

extra_sections.title: What It Means for Families Notes
extra_sections.content:
Orphaned students from SC and ST communities in Tripura who are enrolled in higher education are prioritised for the PRAYAS Scholarship and may be eligible for enhanced support rates under special provisions; the Tripura government recognises that orphaned students face additional vulnerabilities and that the scholarship is particularly critical for their ability to complete their education. The district Social Welfare Officer has discretion to expedite the application of orphaned students and ensure they receive their scholarship at the earliest.

The PRAYAS Scholarship also integrates with Tripura's broader skilling and placement ecosystem by supporting students through the academic phase of their education, after which government programmes for skilling and employment can take over; students who complete their courses with the help of the scholarship are better positioned to access placements, competitive exams, and entrepreneurship support schemes that the state offers to young graduates. In this way, the scholarship is not just a welfare measure but an investment in the long-term human capital development of Tripura's SC and ST population.

faqs.question: What is PRAYAS Scholarship Tripura?
faqs.answer: PRAYAS is a Tripura government scholarship for Scheduled Caste and Scheduled Tribe students pursuing higher education, covering maintenance allowance and tuition fee reimbursement to help them complete degree and professional courses.

faqs.question: Who is eligible for PRAYAS Scholarship?
faqs.answer: SC and ST students who are permanent residents of Tripura, have a family income below Rs 2.5 lakh/year, and are enrolled in a recognised degree, post-graduate, or professional course are eligible.

faqs.question: What is the income limit for PRAYAS Scholarship?
faqs.answer: Annual family income from all sources must be below Rs 2.5 lakh for the student to be eligible.

faqs.question: Does PRAYAS cover professional courses like engineering and medical?
faqs.answer: Yes. Professional courses including engineering, medical, law, pharmacy, nursing, and management are covered under the PRAYAS Scholarship.

faqs.question: How do I apply for PRAYAS Scholarship?
faqs.answer: Apply online through the National Scholarship Portal (scholarships.gov.in) or the Tripura state scholarship portal. Upload your caste certificate, income certificate, mark sheets, and fee receipts, and submit before the closing date.

faqs.question: How is the scholarship paid?
faqs.answer: The scholarship amount is credited directly to the student's Aadhaar-linked bank account through the DBT mechanism after approval by the department and institution verification.

faqs.question: Do I need to renew the scholarship every year?
faqs.answer:
Yes. Renewal requires proof that you passed the previous year's examination and maintained the required attendance.

Apply for renewal within the prescribed period each year.

faqs.question: Can I apply if I study in a college outside Tripura?
faqs.answer: Yes. Tripura's SC and ST students studying in recognised institutions in other states are typically eligible for the PRAYAS Scholarship provided they meet all other eligibility criteria.

faqs.question: Can I receive PRAYAS along with other scholarships?
faqs.answer:
Generally no. PRAYAS is designed to avoid duplication with other state or central scholarships for the same course.

Check the current scholarship notification for specific rules about combining with central scholarships.

faqs.question: Where can I check my application status?
faqs.answer: Log in to the National Scholarship Portal or the Tripura state scholarship portal using your registration number and Aadhaar to check application and payment status.
